_comment: Cluster topology. Copy to /opt/tinyfaas/nodes.json on the controller
Relay assignment verified against the hardware. An earlier version had
every worker on the wrong channel, which made the system power one node
while health-checking another -- so a node left running looked stuck and
a node that never came up looked dead. Confirm with `make verify-wiring`
pi3 sits on 2brr channel 1 and is currently excluded from the cluster.
Its apparent fault was this mapping error, not the node.
The leader is dispatch_only: it schedules and powers nodes but never runs
a function itself, so its draw is constant rather than load-dependent.
